author: Keremia
quote:
13 years and $2,000,000,000 is what Rockstar needs to produce a 30 fps (max) girlfriend satisfaction simulator. Driving around the map and gunfights result in mid to low 20 FPS, first dozen hours are CHORES, and you can’t even steal cars in this “Grand Theft Auto”.

Every single review above 90 needs to be investigated for bias/bribery/fraud.
